sample_unit: UK Core FHIR patient bundles (18,000 scored prompts)

links.outcome: LLM quality across input serialisation formats and under perturbed clinical data
links.effect: Serialisation format significantly changed quality (Kruskal–Wallis H=163.86, Δ=0.24 on 5-point scale); findings replicated under clinically realistic data perturbation; Llama 3.3 sensitivity 0.39 vs Claude Sonnet 4.5 0.10.
links.quote: All findings replicate under clinically realistic data perturbation.

unlisted_practices: Task-aware FHIR-to-text serialisation routing as a zero-cost quality intervention
Comparing token-level F1 with clinical quality metrics for LLM evaluation

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating how input formatting/serialisation choices (FHIR-to-text representation) affect clinical LLM performance and deployment quality.
